source: Heyuan Intelligence Technology, DZS900 Modbus register list (xlsx from the manufacturer download page)
notes: Modbus RTU on two RS-485 ports. Defaults from the register list: address 1, 9600 baud (baud code 3), 8N1; the user manual gives 2400 to 19200 baud and 8N1, 8O1 or 8E1.

The register list says the measured parameters are available as holding registers (function 03) and as input registers (function 04); they are mapped here as holding registers. Addresses are the decimal addresses of the list, address base 0.

Values are 16-bit with fixed multipliers (voltage x100, current x10000, power x100 per phase and x10 for the three-phase total, power factor x1000). The scale here gives the secondary-side value; the list also gives formulas with PT and CT for the primary value (U = register x PT / 100, I = register x CT / 10000, P = register x PT x CT / 100 per phase, / 10 for totals), noted in each description.

The three-phase and single-phase layouts share the same addresses: the list shows three-phase circuits 1 to 9 or, in the single-phase layout, loops 1 to 27. The registers are named by three-phase circuit and the single-phase loop name is given in the description.
Energy values are 32-bit, in 0.01 kWh (kvarh) steps; the list does not state the word order, so high word first is assumed.
Written from the manufacturer's register list; not tested on a device.
description: Multi-circuit energy meter (up to 9 three-phase or 27 single-phase circuits): voltages, currents, powers, power factors, per-circuit energies, configuration and the clear-energy command
